The cheapest listed offer per combination is not necessarily in the target central neighborhoods. Cheaper different accommodation products (including floating hostels) are not evidence of a drop in the same hotel/room; winter comfort and room occupancy require confirmation. AJet direct service may operate Thu/Sun (schedule source), but an exact booking-class fare and checked-bag total for 31 Dec–3 Jan remain unverified. The prior itinerary totals are retained as historical references; no confirmed historic low-price threshold reached.
